tool_input.command:
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
$src = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile("$PWD\.tmp-bug6073.png")
$rect = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle(820, 350, 280, 60)
$bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap(1120, 240)
$g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)
$g.InterpolationMode = 'NearestNeighbor'
$g.DrawImage($src, (New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle(0,0,1120,240)), $rect, 'Pixel')
$bmp.Save("$PWD\.tmp-crop.png", [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
$g.Dispose(); $bmp.Dispose(); $src.Dispose()
Write-Output 'ok'
tool_input.description: Crop and upscale the button region of the screenshot
